doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: Where Globe Hall stood and what it looked like
summary: Russell asks where the Globe Hall was. Tom and Martin place it near Congress Square beside the basin, a tall upstairs hall entered from Crown Letters Wall with a bandstand six or seven feet high, like Economy Hall.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I'm going to ask a bit more about Globe Hall. I still don't know exactly where it was. It was in the square, like where the Beauregard or they used to call it Congress Square. That's right here. Yeah, right up here. And is it right on the edge of that? It was right on the back of it.
Right on St. Peter Street on that side.
On the back of it. On the uptown side.
On the uptown side. On the uptown side of St. Peter. And the basin was right next to it. Right next to that.
Yeah, the old basin. It was a pretty big hall and more than one story. What was that?
It was a big hall. You see? And they had a row of houses that used to go right straight. Yeah. Yeah, a row of houses. And right on that side was a big hall. You could see from a Rapport Street.
He used to sit there in the square. And see? Right in the next street. Yeah, right there. You see the back of it was on St. Peter. And the front of it was on Crown Letters Wall.
Yeah.
You could go in on Crown Letters Wall. And go upstairs in the front. Upstairs, that's right. Right next to the blacksmith there.
That's right.
That's right.
See? And the dancers were upstairs. Upstairs. Yeah.
It was a big high room or what was it looked like? It was a big hall. It was a hall hall but it was high. It had a lot of parlance on it, you understand? Yeah. Yeah. It was right there by the basin.
Yeah. Right by the basin. At that time they called it Cronlet. Cronlet Wall. Yeah. It was a big hall hall.

Yeah. What was the bandstand like? How high was the bandstand or what was it like? Well the bandstand had a room right in the back. Right in the back. Right up there. Was it up pretty high or like up in the back?
Yeah. It wasn't there. The bandstand, the bandstand didn't. It was as high as that door. Yeah. Six, seven feet high. It was like the economy hall. It was like the economy hall.
Yeah. I've seen that, yeah.
Well that's the same way it was in the globe hall.
In the globe hall. The same way. A friend of mine took a picture in the economy hall. It's still over there. The church. Yeah. Yeah. It still had the old balcony on the bandstand.
Yeah. The stand ain't there though.
